messages:
Maya (Fleet): Vendor just updated lead time for upcoming H100 shipment: standard now 7w (was 4w). They also reported a partial-DOA run and want to RMA 15 units, shipping replacements in two waves.
Sam (Procurement): Oof. Do we have buffer to cover a 3-week slip? cc @Hiro for RMA specifics. :grimacing:
Hiro (Logistics): Staging EU pool has 12 unallocated H100s, but 22 units are on hold for serial reconciliation. RMA batch = 15 units. Vendor proposes crossdock replacement for 10 units and credit/refund for remaining 5 (they later increased to 7 in negotiations).
Maya (Fleet): If lead times stretch to 7w we need options: expedite some replacements by air, top up later, or shift workloads to other regions. What's the air-expedite uplift? @vendor-liaison-bot please paste rates.
vendor-liaison-bot: Vendor update: standard replacements ETA 7w. Air-expedite = +$6,000/unit, up to 8 units max per tranche. Customs paperwork unchanged. PO ref RF-998122.
Sam (Procurement): $6k * 8 = $48k. Market spot for 8 H100s looks >$90k, so expedite seems cost-effective. Recommend expedite 8 units and take credit for the remainder.
Hiro (Logistics): RMA serial manifest (15 units):
H100-AB12-0001
H100-AB12-0002
H100-AB12-0003
H100-AB12-0004
H100-AB12-0005
H100-AB12-0006
H100-AB12-0007
H100-AB12-0008
H100-AB12-0009
H100-AB12-0010
H100-AB12-0011
H100-AB12-0012
H100-AB12-0013
H100-AB12-0014
H100-AB12-0015
Pickup window for depot return: Fri 09:00-17:00. Carrier will provide AWB after vendor confirms expedite list.
Lee (SRE): Losing 15 EU H100s reduces our reserve ~30% for training lanes and ~15% for production inference. If we expedite 8, still short ~7 units; we can shift two prod clusters to Dedicated pool temporarily but costs rise ~+25% for that period.
Maya (Fleet): Tradeoffs: expedite 8 to restore critical training capacity, accept credit for remaining units, and use Dedicated burst for any residual shortfall.
Sam (Procurement): I'll try to negotiate lower expedite fees. Ask vendor if $4k/unit for 8 expedited units is possible if remaining 7 convert to a 6-month conditional credit. Also request HS code confirmation to avoid customs delays.
vendor-liaison-bot: Vendor reply: can do $5k/unit if Redwood accepts 6-month credit for the 7 non-expedited units (credit = 65% of unit price). HS code confirmed as 8542.31. AWB for expedited units available within 48h after PO amendment. Ticket TKT-55801.
Sam (Procurement): Counter-sent $4.2k/unit OR $5k + 30% service credit on next order. Drafted PO amendment PO RF-998122-A1. Looping Legal for credit clause.
Maya (Fleet): Approve expedite if $4.2k accepted. @Hiro confirm customs clearance timeline and depot pickup schedule if they AWB within 48h so we can update schedulers.
Hiro (Logistics): If AWB in 48h, customs release typically 24-48h EU inland. Depot pickup then Mon-Wed next week. I'll prebook carrier and share pickup SLA and manifest.
Lee (SRE): I'll throttle noncritical jobs and extend KV-cache TTL to reduce token cost during capacity shortage. Temp scheduler command:
# temporary scheduler stop
rk cluster update --pool eu-training --max-inflight 40
Maya (Fleet): Good. Sam add negotiated terms to PO and have Legal sign off on credit. If vendor refuses, fallback is split: spot-buy 4-5 units now and Dedicated-burst remainder.
Sam (Procurement): On it. Sent final ask to vendor: $4.2k expedite + credit clause. Expect vendor confirm EOD. Looping Legal.
Maya (Fleet): Thanks all. Reconvene when vendor confirms. :thumbsup:
Lee (SRE): 👍 monitoring and will push cluster policy changes once Hiro confirms pickup.
Hiro (Logistics): AWB/tracking to follow post-confirmation; will post short manifest and pickup ETA in thread.
vendor-liaison-bot: Vendor acknowledged Redwood counterproposal. SLA for reply 24-48h. Reference TKT-55801 and PO RF-998122-A1.
